'''Jorrn Kresh''', known as '''Boss Jorrn''', was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who controlled a [[Jorrn Kresh gang|gang]]. His gang attempted to force protection money from [[Grison Jarn]] but he recounted his misfortunes and told them he had nothing left worth protecting.
